description: This file manages the copying and bundling of plugin metadata, including handling plugin directories, dependencies, and skills for a Node.js-based project. It processes plugin manifests and package.json files, rewrites package extensions, and handles skill paths with retries, ensuring proper structure and dependency management during build steps.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main function to copy plugin metadata, process plugin directories, generate bundled manifests, and handle dependency paths.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level public surface files from a plugin directory, excluding test and config files, used for determining support package eligibility.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a plugin is a support package based on its directory name, package name, and public surface entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites extensions in package.json to use .js files instead of other extensions.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Rewrites a setup entry path in package.json to ensure it uses a .js extension.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Ensures a given path stays within a specified root directory, throwing an error if it escapes.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes raw paths in manifests to use forward slashes and removes leading ./

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute source path of a skill, checking plugin directory and node_modules.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Resolves the output path for a skill, relocating node_modules-based skills into a bundled directory.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a transient error suitable for retries during copying.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous sleep for specified milliseconds using Atomics.wait.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Attempts to copy a skill path with retries on transient errors.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies all declared skills in a plugin manifest to a distribution directory, with dependency filtering.
